statement: Pinned Dolphin's IR extended camera record is three bytes per tracked point: eight low bits of X, eight low bits of Y, then a byte packing a four-bit point-size and the high two bits of each 10-bit coordinate. The emulator emits one such record per available synthetic camera point and uses unavailable-point markers for missing observations; this is Dolphin representation, not guaranteed physical camera fidelity.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Camera.h 65-84; Camera.cpp 112-138. Separately scoped from PR16 basic/extended mode byte counts to cover metadata semantics.
